purpose: Second-layer semantic metadata for AI-assisted LP editing. This file describes which DOM elements are safe to target without changing the Illustrator/PDF-derived visual geometry.

section_container.notes: Use data-section-id together with src/ai-map.json to locate the intended section.

heading.notes: Visible copy is commonly duplicated between the SVG text and the .lp-selection-text span. When changing copy, update both representations and preserve positioning/styles unless explicitly asked to redesign.

selection_text.notes: Do not edit this span alone when a matching SVG <text> exists; it is primarily a selectable/accessibility text layer.

native_svg_text.notes: This is normally the visually rendered text. Keep it synchronized with the corresponding .lp-selection-text content. Preserve x/y/font/style attributes unless a layout change is requested.

cta_link.notes: href/target/rel can be changed without disturbing geometry. Confirm the intended product destination before changing URLs.

image_asset.notes: Prefer replacing only href when swapping an image. Preserve x/y/width/height/preserveAspectRatio unless resizing or repositioning is explicitly requested.

vector_geometry.selector: path, clipPath, polygon, polyline, rect, circle, ellipse, line
vector_geometry.notes: Illustrator/PDF-derived geometry. Do not alter for ordinary text, link, SEO, or image-reference changes. Edit only for a specifically requested visual correction.

section_dimensions.notes: Do not change section ratio/viewBox for ordinary maintenance. These values control visual fidelity.

water-and-giving-cycle.notes: Contains diagrams and dense vector artwork; avoid geometry edits unless requested.

silica-age-related-decline.notes: Scientific graph/evidence block. Text and citation edits are safer than vector graph geometry; verify claims before changing factual content.

natural-minerals-and-silica-75mg.notes: Contains quantitative product claims; preserve approved figures unless explicitly changed.

daily-water-loss-and-hydration.notes: Health-related explanatory copy; do not strengthen claims without evidence.

support-costs-and-transparency.notes: Legal/transparency wording should remain faithful to approved operational facts.

accounting-reporting-and-activity-result.notes: Reporting figures and institutional descriptions should be changed only from approved source data.

default_edit_sequence: Resolve the requested section through src/ai-map.json.
Open only that src/sections/section-XX.html file plus src/styles.css when styling is involved.
Prefer semantic/text/link/image-reference changes over SVG geometry changes.
For copy changes, synchronize SVG visible text and matching selection text.
Preserve coordinates, clip paths, viewBox, section ratio, transforms, and paint order unless the request explicitly requires a visual-layout change.
Do not edit generated index.html directly.
Commit the source edit and let the GitHub Actions build regenerate index.html.
Confirm the Build ecforce index.html workflow completed successfully.
